machine.text: Commands can also run on this computer, with its own programs and servers: open a terminal in one of your folders and paste this line. Tasks with that folder then run their commands there, until you press Ctrl+C in that terminal.
machine.on: Tasks with the folder {folder} run their commands on this computer, each asked first, until you press Ctrl+C in its terminal.
machine.question: Run this on your computer, in {folder}?
